title: Comin' Through the Rye
transcription:
Comin' Through the Rye

If a body meet a body
Comin' through the rye
If a body kiss a body
Need a body cry?

Chorus:
Ev'ry lassie has her laddie
Nane, they say, ha' I
Yet all the lads they smile on me
When comin' through the rye

If a body meet a body
Comin' from the town
If a body greet a body
Need a body frown?

Chorus
notes: Draft song-level split from visual page transcription. Source page note: Draft visual transcription from photographed page spread. Some small words are uncertain because of image softness, especially in McPhearson's Farewell and Woad.
